behavior: Restricts the new GFA transport to one-byte reads; other lengths return 0xFD until separately validated.
Adds vs12_adapter.read_gfa_ext(); in VS2 mode it returns unsupported 0xAF and never switches protocols implicitly.
Adds poll marker gfa:<format>, e.g. gfa:30 or gfa:0.3922.
Does not add any GFA_WRITE, PROCESS_WRITE, coding, actuator or safety write path.
Quarantines one-byte 0xFF GFA replies as acquisition failure so they are not published as physical values such as P06=7650 rpm.
